intent: R2dbcHistoryStore implements HistoryStore over DatabaseClient. SI-05 append-only-history: insert-only, no update or delete member. SI-07 tenant-scoped-query: byIdAndTenant binds tenantId as a parameter on the lookup, never concatenated. PB-14 page-size-limit: every list query binds LIMIT :limit from chat.history.page.size, clamped to chat.history.page.max. PB-17 pool-limit: spring.r2dbc.pool.max-size is 10. Duplicate key is a no-op returning false.

methods.semantics: true when the row was inserted; false for a duplicate identity (nothing written)

methods.signature: Mono<Boolean> appendUsage(String sessionId, String turnId, String tenantId, int promptTokens, int completionTokens)
methods.semantics: true when the usage row was inserted; false when the session id + turn id already has one (duplicate)
